execution_scope.emulation: QEMU Linux user mode executing target native instructions; not physical-device hardware qualification
execution_scope.local_work: mechanical source edits, freeze/archive/hash and evidence collection only
execution_scope.concurrent_work: no reset/stash/commit/push; unrelated edits preserved; integration tests cover named immutable cuts

implementation.native_step: architecture-specific software breakpoints, actual selected-thread Linux signal frames, sealed owned-function successor plans, trap revisions, exact original byte restoration and actual worker retirement
implementation.numeric_registers: actual GPR/FP bits copied only through authenticated compiler-emitted numeric register-only locations; unqualified GPR and FP bytes cleared; unproved upper bits masked
implementation.code_origin: only actual validated numeric definitions and the exact compiler-created empty tied numeric identity qualify column 1; foreign inline assembly, pointers, loads/stores and SP/FP operands remain hidden
implementation.i686: debug-provenance builds reserve EBP using frame-pointer=all; numeric identity origin avoids zero-byte assembly column conflicts
implementation.decoder: actual MCTargetOptions lifetime retained with MC decoder; AArch64 numeric shifted-register operand forms recognized without permitting memory/SP/FP
implementation.shutdown: Monotonic process-lifetime atomic byte is only a hint; requested path rechecks Acquire and ownership under the original host poll mutex before a Wasm effect
implementation.io: new C++ output/formatting uses fast_io; native syscall backend uses fast_io::system_call
implementation.build_opt_in: --linux-native-debug=y with Linux LLVM/Clang JIT and an actually qualified native-owner-table-v2 SDK; --linux-x64-native-debug=y remains x86_64 only

isolation_contract.coverage_note: Assertions and source checks establish the recorded scenarios; this record is not a proof covering arbitrary future code or every opcode.

environment_interpretation: Fresh compiler/test commands exited zero and ran inside the original cgroup. Their original strict receipts are retained, including shared memory.events changes; they are not relabelled PASS. Separate pinned-binary execution replays passed with unchanged memory.events. Replay does not retroactively qualify the original build environment.
qualification_limits: PPC32 and SPARC64 complete Wasm MCJIT products remain gated by existing incomplete ELF loaders; signal/backend fixtures do not authorize relaxing these gates.
PPC64/PPC64LE/MIPS64/MIPS64EL/LoongArch64/SystemZ/ARM-state have real backend fixture evidence, but no complete target Wasm runtime product qualification in this run.
ARM-state is tested; Thumb generated code is refused before patching.
RV64GC has no native v128 register class in this matrix; i686 i64 split/bit-piece locations remain unavailable. Missing hardware or unproved locations are not synthesized.
This run does not qualify standalone interactive CLI main, C++ modules, Xmake project loading, all Wasm 3.0 opcodes, all native instruction forms, performance parity or all language/WASIp1 levels.
RV64 runtime logs contain ignored negative -zicfiss feature warnings from the pinned SDK; this run does not qualify clean interactive console output.
Current-source frontend checks cover their own later immutable snapshot. Full execution checks cover the exact final snapshot and the matching implementation files recorded above.
raw_evidence: Per-command argv, exit code, elapsed time, log hashes, source manifests, actual emitted object hashes and PIDFD retirement receipts are retained under each named cut.
